sentences.zh: 另一个热那亚人，安东尼奥·诺利，是第一个为葡萄牙人在佛得角群岛建立定居点的人。

sentences.en: And the Genoese, in all of this, one of the things they are doing, and that Columbus definitely does not invent, is they are trading slaves.
sentences.zh: 而在这一切中，热那亚人正在做的一件事，也是哥伦布绝对没有发明的一件事，就是他们在进行奴隶贸易。

sentences.en: The Mediterranean is this great slave trading network, and the Genoese are at the forefront of that.
sentences.zh: 地中海是一个巨大的奴隶贸易网络，而热那亚人处于最前沿。

sentences.en: And Dominic, is that because while they were in the East, they could trade in all the riches of the East, the spices and so on?
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，这是因为当他们在东方时，他们可以交易东方所有的财富，香料等等吗？

sentences.en: Once that starts to get closed off to them, what else is there for them to trade, except for slaves?
sentences.zh: 一旦那条路开始对他们关闭，除了奴隶，他们还能交易什么呢？

sentences.en: The West is much less advanced.
sentences.zh: 西方要落后得多。

sentences.en: There's much less natural resources than you would get, say, from the Indies.
sentences.zh: 那里的自然资源比你从印度得到的要少得多。

sentences.en: Well, they're trading olive oil, they're trading some sugar.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们在交易橄榄油，交易一些糖。

sentences.en: So they are trading, I think, some commodities, but slaves are very lucrative.
sentences.zh: 所以我想他们确实在交易一些商品，但奴隶非常有利可图。

sentences.en: There are an awful lot of slaves in Portugal and in Spain.
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙和西班牙有大量的奴隶。

sentences.en: But they're domestic slaves, aren't they?
sentences.zh: 但他们是家奴，不是吗？

sentences.en: So they're not yet establishing plantations or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 所以他们还没有建立种植园之类的东西。

sentences.en: So they're not working on plantations in Spain and Portugal.
sentences.zh: 所以他们并没有在西班牙和葡萄牙的种植园里工作。

sentences.en: I mean, we'll perhaps touch on this again a little bit later, but if you were a sort of
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们稍后可能会再谈到这一点，但如果你是一个

sentences.en: Spanish bigwig, or indeed a Spanish, you know, part of the sort of professional or middle
sentences.zh: 西班牙的大人物，或者确实是西班牙的，你知道，属于某种专业人士或中产阶级，

sentences.en: classes, entrepreneurial classes, let's say, a merchant or something, or a clerk or whatever, it's quite likely that you would have one or two slaves.
sentences.zh: 创业阶层，比方说，一个商人什么的，或者一个职员之类的，你很有可能会有一两个奴隶。

sentences.en: And a lot of those slaves are Berbers from North Africa.
sentences.zh: 而这些奴隶中有很多是来自北非的柏柏尔人。

sentences.en: Some of them are black slaves brought by the Portuguese from the west coast of Africa, but probably the majority are Eastern European.
sentences.zh: 其中一些是葡萄牙人从非洲西海岸带来的黑人奴隶，但大多数可能还是东欧人。

sentences.en: Well, so hence they're Slavs.
sentences.zh: 嗯，所以他们就是斯拉夫人。

sentences.en: Yes, Slavs.
sentences.zh: 是的，斯拉夫人。

sentences.en: Hence the name.
sentences.zh: 名字由此而来。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So they, and that's a practice that obviously has been carried to its kind of peak in the
sentences.zh: 所以他们，这种做法显然在奥斯曼帝国达到了顶峰。

sentences.en: Ottoman Empire.
sentences.zh: 奥斯曼帝国。

sentences.en: So in the Ottoman Empire, they have loads and loads of slaves and lots of Eastern European slaves.
sentences.zh: 所以在奥斯曼帝国，他们有大量的奴隶，还有很多东欧奴隶。

sentences.en: And the Genoese have been part of that business, you know, across the sort of Black Sea and the Mediterranean slave trading.
sentences.zh: 热那亚人也参与了那项生意，你知道，跨越黑海和地中海的奴隶贸易。

sentences.en: So that's the world that Columbus is born into.
sentences.zh: 这就是哥伦布出生的世界。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so as someone who is poor, but ambitious, he's not educated.
sentences.zh: 作为一个贫穷但有野心的人，他没有受过教育。

sentences.en: I mean, he will, you know, he's an autodidact.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他会，你知道，他是自学成才的。

sentences.en: He will come to have read a lot.
sentences.zh: 他后来读了很多书。

sentences.en: But to begin with, you know, he doesn't have a career in the church, doesn't beckon.
sentences.zh: 但起初，你知道，他没有在教会谋得职位，也没有人召唤他。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: So he could become a soldier.
sentences.zh: 所以他可以成为一名士兵。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: But it's more obvious if you are Genoese to become a sailor.
sentences.zh: 但如果你是热那亚人，成为一名水手显然更顺理成章。

sentences.en: And so he goes to sea very young and he kind of absorbs that familiarity with winds and rope and all that stuff that I know absolutely nothing about, but which if you're a young
sentences.zh: 所以他很小就出海了，他吸收了那种对风向、绳索以及所有我一窍不通的东西的熟悉感，但如果你是一个年轻的

sentences.en: Genoese sailor, you know all about it.
sentences.zh: 热那亚水手，你对这些了如指掌。

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: I think he, there's some talk later on that he might've studied at the University of
sentences.zh: 我想他，后来有一些传言说他可能在帕维亚大学学习过，

sentences.en: Pavia, but I think a lot of biographers don't think he did.
sentences.zh: 但我认为很多传记作者并不这么认为。

sentences.en: His son claims that he did, but probably that's part of that sort of burnishing of his legend.
sentences.zh: 他的儿子声称他读过，但这可能只是他传奇故事中润色的一部分。

sentences.en: As you said, he's an autodidact and we'll touch on that a little bit in a second.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，他是自学成才的，我们稍后会谈到这一点。

sentences.en: He probably goes to sea when he's mid-teens, maybe 14, possibly later.
sentences.zh: 他可能在十几岁时就出海了，也许是14岁，也可能更晚。

sentences.en: He goes, where does he go?
sentences.zh: 他去了，他去了哪里？

sentences.en: We know he goes to Tunis.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他去了突尼斯。

sentences.en: We know he goes to the Genoese have colony on the Greek island of Chios, which is off the coast of modern day Turkey.
sentences.zh: 我们知道他去了热那亚人在希腊希俄斯岛上的殖民地，那是在现代土耳其海岸外。

sentences.en: But he ends up in Portugal.
sentences.zh: 但他最终去了葡萄牙。

sentences.en: That's a very well-worn route for Genoese mariners.
sentences.zh: 这对热那亚水手来说是一条非常成熟的路线。

sentences.en: So he's working for the, one of these big Genoese firms, the one I mentioned earlier, the
sentences.zh: 所以他当时在为热那亚的大公司之一工作，就是我之前提到的那家，

sentences.en: Centurioni family.
sentences.zh: 森图里奥尼家族。

sentences.en: And actually your Soprano's opening, you know, the idea of these families that are really important kind of, you know, that a family is a commercial enterprise and Columbus knows
sentences.zh: 其实就像《黑道家族》的开场，你知道，这些家族非常重要，你知道，家族就是一种商业企业，而哥伦布认识

sentences.en: some of the most important families.
sentences.zh: 一些最重要的家族。

sentences.en: So the Portuguese have established plantations in Madeira and they are already employing black
sentences.zh: 所以葡萄牙人在马德拉群岛建立了种植园，他们已经在马德拉雇佣了黑人

sentences.en: African slaves in Madeira.
sentences.zh: 非洲奴隶。

sentences.en: So again, the idea that Columbus is the guy, as people sometimes say, he's the guy who institutes
sentences.zh: 所以，正如人们有时所说，哥伦布是那个开创了

sentences.en: the practice of bringing black African slaves across the Atlantic to work in plantations.
sentences.zh: 将黑人非洲奴隶带过大西洋到种植园工作的做法的人，这种想法其实是不对的。

sentences.en: The Portuguese are actually already doing it.
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙人其实已经在做了。

sentences.en: And he probably would have seen that when he went to Madeira.
sentences.zh: 他去马德拉时很可能已经看到了这一点。

sentences.en: And so Dominic, presumably to begin with, his sailing has been done within the Mediterranean.
sentences.zh: 那么，多米尼克，大概起初，他的航行都是在地中海内进行的。

sentences.en: So inside the Straits of Gibraltar.
sentences.zh: 也就是在直布罗陀海峡之内。

sentences.en: But now he, Portugal is an Atlantic facing power.
sentences.zh: 但现在他，葡萄牙是一个面向大西洋的强国。

sentences.en: So he is starting to become familiar with the winds, the currents, all that malarkey of the Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 所以他开始熟悉大西洋的风向、洋流以及所有那些乱七八糟的东西。

sentences.en: Am I right that he sails both very far south and very far north?
sentences.zh: 我没说错吧，他既航行到过很远的南方，也到过很远的北方？

sentences.en: So he sails all the way to the kind of the gold coast of Guinea and all that kind of stuff in the south.
sentences.zh: 是的，他一路航行到几内亚的黄金海岸，以及南方所有那些地方。

sentences.en: And then he does this extraordinary voyage.
sentences.zh: 然后他进行了那次非凡的航行。

sentences.en: He visits Bristol.
sentences.zh: 他访问了布里斯托尔。

sentences.en: He goes to Galway in Ireland.
sentences.zh: 他去了爱尔兰的戈尔韦。

sentences.en: And he goes all the way to Iceland.
sentences.zh: 他还一路去了冰岛。

sentences.en: That's absolutely right, Tom.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，汤姆。

sentences.en: So he definitely went to West Africa.
sentences.zh: 所以他确实去过西非。

sentences.en: The Portuguese are very busy in West Africa.
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙人在西非非常活跃。

sentences.en: The Portuguese have a business model that the Spanish do not follow.
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙人有一种西班牙人没有遵循的商业模式。

sentences.en: So this is why it actually really matters that Columbus ends up sailing for Spain rather than for Portugal.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么哥伦布最终为西班牙而不是葡萄牙航行真的很重要。

sentences.en: So the Portuguese business model is they will establish trading posts, fortresses, but they don't tend to settle.
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙的商业模式是建立贸易站、堡垒，但他们往往不进行定居。

sentences.en: So the Portuguese have this very famous sort of slaving fortress called Elmina on the Gold
sentences.zh: 所以葡萄牙人有一个非常有名的奴隶堡垒，叫埃尔米纳，位于黄金

sentences.en: Coast, Guinea.
sentences.zh: 海岸，几内亚。

sentences.en: And they are basically buying slaves there and shipping them to Madeira.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是在那里购买奴隶，然后把他们运往马德拉。

sentences.en: Columbus almost certainly visited that.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布几乎肯定访问过那里。

sentences.en: And he would have traveled on these Portuguese, these very innovative Portuguese ships called caravels.
sentences.zh: 他当时乘坐的应该是那些葡萄牙人非常有创意的船只，叫卡拉维尔帆船。

sentences.en: We know all about them, don't we?
sentences.zh: 我们对它们都很了解，不是吗？

sentences.en: Of course, famously, Tom, have triangular sails, triangular rigging.
sentences.zh: 当然，众所周知，汤姆，它们有三角形的帆，三角形的索具。

sentences.en: Perhaps you'd like to explain to the listeners what the advantage of a triangular sail is.
sentences.zh: 也许你想向听众解释一下三角形帆的优势是什么。

sentences.en: You're so predictable that you think you would...
sentences.zh: 你真是太好预测了，你以为你会……

sentences.en: I thought to myself, Tom will ask me some smug question, snide question about triangular sails to try and expose migrants.
sentences.zh: 我心想，汤姆会问我一些自鸣得意、尖酸刻薄的问题，关于三角形帆，试图揭露移民。

sentences.en: Have you mastered it?
sentences.zh: 你掌握了吗？

sentences.en: Well, it's all a question of Latine rigging, Tom, as I'm sure you know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这全是关于拉丁帆索具的问题，汤姆，我相信你是知道的。

sentences.en: So they've picked up the practice of Latine rigging from the Arabs.
sentences.zh: 所以他们从阿拉伯人那里学到了拉丁帆索具的做法。

sentences.en: Latine rigging means you do have triangular rigging around the square.
sentences.zh: 拉丁帆索具意味着你在方形帆周围确实有三角形的索具。

sentences.en: It means you're quicker.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你速度更快。

sentences.en: It means you're more maneuverable.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你更灵活。

sentences.en: So yes, so you didn't think I would be prepared for this.
sentences.zh: 所以是的，你没想到我会为此做好准备吧。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没有。

sentences.en: I feel like the Romans blundering into an ambush set by Hannibal.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己就像掉进汉尼拔设下的埋伏的罗马人。

sentences.en: A German foreSt.
sentences.zh: 一片德国森林。

sentences.en: That's what it is.
sentences.zh: 就是那样。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: It's the Battle of the Teutoburg ForeSt.
sentences.zh: 那是条顿堡森林战役。

sentences.en: That's what this episode will be remembered for.
sentences.zh: 这就是这一集会被记住的原因。

sentences.en: I'm glad you talked to that.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你谈到了这一点。

sentences.en: And the winds are very important.
sentences.zh: 风向非常重要。

sentences.en: And we'll come to them.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后会谈到它们。

sentences.en: They're terribly important.
sentences.zh: 它们非常重要。

sentences.en: But just, you mentioned about going north.
sentences.zh: 但刚才，你提到了向北航行。

sentences.en: He does go north.
sentences.zh: 他确实向北航行了。

sentences.en: He goes to Iceland and he goes to Ireland and probably to Bristol.
sentences.zh: 他去了冰岛，去了爱尔兰，可能还去了布里斯托尔。

sentences.en: And at this point in the 15th century, there's a lot of sort of gossip about whether there could be something to the weSt.
sentences.zh: 而在15世纪的这个时候，有很多关于西方是否可能存在某种东西的流言蜚语。

sentences.en: So people talk about an imaginary island, which they called Antilla.
sentences.zh: 所以人们谈论一个虚构的岛屿，他们称之为安提利亚。

sentences.en: Hence, that's where we get the word Antilles from.
sentences.zh: 因此，这就是我们得到“安的列斯群岛”这个词的由来。

sentences.en: And that, very importantly, is supposedly to have been settled by Portuguese refugees from the Arab invasions of Spain.
sentences.zh: 而且非常重要的一点是，据说那里是由阿拉伯入侵西班牙时的葡萄牙难民定居的。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: So this idea that there is a Portuguese settlement somewhere out there.
sentences.zh: 所以这种认为在某个地方有一个葡萄牙定居点的想法。

sentences.en: I mean, these may be, who knows whether some of these things may be kind of folk memories of the Viking expeditions.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这些可能是，谁知道呢，其中一些东西可能是维京探险队的民间记忆。

sentences.en: Contact with Greenland was probably lost only a generation or two before Columbus was born.
sentences.zh: 与格陵兰岛的联系可能在哥伦布出生前一两代人就断绝了。

sentences.en: So it's possible.
sentences.zh: 所以这是有可能的。

sentences.en: But the other island that people think is out there is an island called Brazil.
sentences.zh: 但人们认为存在的另一个岛屿是一个叫巴西的岛屿。

sentences.en: So people have a sort of fantasy of Brazil before Brazil itself exists.
sentences.zh: 所以人们在巴西本身存在之前就对巴西有一种幻想。

sentences.en: The derivation is different, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想词源是不同的。

sentences.en: So Brazil today, as in Pele and everything, derives from the name of a tree that apparently gives a red dye.
sentences.zh: 所以今天的巴西，就像贝利和所有那些东西，源于一种据说能提供红色染料的树的名字。

sentences.en: Some people think the tree is named after the legendary island.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为这棵树是以那个传说中的岛屿命名的。

sentences.en: So actually, it became self-fulfilling.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，它变成了一种自我实现的预言。

sentences.en: But the Brazil that people in the, before the discovery of the New World are talking about is set in the North Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 但在新大陆发现之前，人们谈论的巴西是位于北大西洋的。

sentences.en: It is, indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And it reflects these kind of traditions that people in Bristol, perhaps, you know, there's
sentences.zh: 它反映了布里斯托尔人的那种传统，也许，你知道，有

sentences.en: the idea that sailors from Bristol, perhaps, are going to Newfoundland or even before Columbus discovers America to go fishing there.
sentences.zh: 一种想法，即来自布里斯托尔的水手，也许在哥伦布发现美洲之前就已经去纽芬兰甚至更远的地方捕鱼了。

sentences.en: Might Columbus have picked up reports of Greenland and maybe even Vinland in Iceland?
sentences.zh: 哥伦布是否可能在冰岛听到过关于格陵兰岛甚至文兰的报道？

sentences.en: I mean, if he's gone as far as Iceland, why wouldn't he have picked up rumors of something out there to the West?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果他已经走到了冰岛，为什么他没有听到关于西方有东西的传闻呢？

sentences.en: And then there's this extraordinary detail that he reports, having seen flat-faced castaways in Galway that he thinks might have come from Cathay.
sentences.zh: 然后还有一个非凡的细节，他报告说在戈尔韦看到了面孔扁平的遇难者，他认为他们可能来自契丹。

sentences.en: And he cites as well a note of Indian merchants who supposedly had come ashore in Germany in the 12th century.
sentences.zh: 他还引用了12世纪据说在德国上岸的印度商人的记录。

sentences.en: So he's obviously starting to kind of pick up these maybe folk tales of people coming across the Atlantic from, as he sees it, Asia.
sentences.zh: 所以他显然开始收集这些可能来自民间故事的传闻，关于人们从他所认为的亚洲跨越大西洋而来。

sentences.en: Because that's the key, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 因为那是关键，不是吗？

sentences.en: What does he think might be out there?
sentences.zh: 他认为那里可能有什么？

sentences.en: Well, that's the thing.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就是这样。

sentences.en: I think there's a lot of speculation at the time.
sentences.zh: 我认为当时有很多猜测。

sentences.en: And I think we don't have much of a sense of Columbus the man at this point.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为我们此时对哥伦布这个人并没有太多的了解。

sentences.en: You know, he's, what is he, late teens, early 20s.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他，他多大，十几岁末，二十岁出头。

sentences.en: We know he's a Genoese mariner.
sentences.zh: 我们只知道他是一个热那亚水手。

sentences.en: That's all we know.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们所知道的一切。

sentences.en: But we do start to get a sense of him.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实开始对他有了一些了解。

sentences.en: He's the sort of 15th century equivalent of somebody who spent an enormous amount of time in his bedroom reading strange forums on the internet, don't you think?
sentences.zh: 他就像是15世纪版的某个人，花大量时间在卧室里阅读互联网上奇怪的论坛，你不觉得吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, he's picking up everything he can from kind of in presumably sailors' taverns and on ships.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他从水手酒馆和船上尽可能地吸收一切信息。

sentences.en: And he's fascinated by this idea of Asia, which we'll come to in a second.
sentences.zh: 而且他被这个亚洲的想法所吸引，我们稍后会谈到这一点。

sentences.en: We wouldn't have Christopher Columbus.

sentences.en: And Columbus, to use that analogy, go back to that analogy of the sort of the teenager in
sentences.zh: 而哥伦布，用那个类比来说，回到那个在卧室里阅读暗网的青少年的类比，

sentences.en: his bedroom reading on the dark web, you know, reading wacky theories about COVID or Russia or whatever.
sentences.zh: 你知道，阅读关于新冠病毒或俄罗斯之类的古怪理论。

sentences.en: Columbus is reading all this stuff about the Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 哥伦布正在阅读所有关于大西洋的东西。

sentences.en: And he becomes completely convinced that, as it were, the mainstream media are misrepresenting the size of the Atlantic and that you can cross it.
sentences.zh: 他变得完全确信，主流媒体歪曲了大西洋的大小，你是可以横渡它的。

sentences.en: But Dominic, isn't there also the fact that he kind of needs to believe that?
sentences.zh: 但是多米尼克，难道不是因为他需要相信这一点吗？

sentences.en: Because if he wants to go on this voyage across the Atlantic, he needs a sponsor.
sentences.zh: 因为如果他想进行这次横渡大西洋的航行，他需要赞助人。

sentences.en: To get a sponsor, he needs to convince the sponsor that it's going to be worth their while.
sentences.zh: 为了获得赞助，他需要让赞助人相信这值得一试。

sentences.en: And if it's Antipodes, who knows what might be there?
sentences.zh: 如果那是对跖点，谁知道那里会有什么？

sentences.en: You can't be sure.
sentences.zh: 你无法确定。

sentences.en: If it's just a bunch of islands, like the Canary Islands or whatever, well, so what?
sentences.zh: 如果只是一堆岛屿，像加那利群岛之类的，那又怎样？

sentences.en: But if you can get to Asia with all its spices, get to India with all its wealth, silks, spices and so on, then that's great.
sentences.zh: 但如果你能到达拥有各种香料的亚洲，到达拥有财富、丝绸、香料等的印度，那才棒。

sentences.en: Absolutely right, Tom.
sentences.zh: 完全正确，汤姆。

sentences.en: Absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So he kind of, I mean, I can see that he believes it.
sentences.zh: 所以他有点，我的意思是，我能看出他是相信的。

sentences.en: He comes to believe it.
sentences.zh: 他开始相信这一点。

sentences.en: But basically, it needs to be Asia, because otherwise he's not going to get the sponsorship.
sentences.zh: 但基本上，它必须是亚洲，否则他将无法获得赞助。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So you probably could, might be able to get sponsorship if you said there's something like the
sentences.zh: 所以你可能，也许能获得赞助，如果你说那里有像加那利群岛那样的地方，我们可以种植糖，只要它不太远。

sentences.en: Canary Islands where we can grow sugar, as long as it's not too far away.
sentences.zh: 但你是完全正确的。

sentences.en: But you're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 如果那是另一块大陆，谁知道那里有什么？

sentences.en: If it's another continent, well, who knows what's there?
sentences.zh: 谁在乎呢？

sentences.en: Who cares?
sentences.zh: 那要花很多钱。

sentences.en: It's a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 但如果是日本、中国和印度，有着人们绝对知道存在的各种香料，而且他们知道这些东西非常有价值，那么当然，它就更有吸引力了。

sentences.en: But if it's Japan and China and the Indies with all their spices, which people absolutely know are there, and they know that this stuff is very valuable, then of course, it's
sentences.zh: 他绝对需要国家赞助。

sentences.en: much more attractive.
sentences.zh: 他就像一个梦想着科技初创公司的人，需要国家赞助，不仅是因为他需要风险投资，而且因为到达某个地方后如果没有国家的支持是毫无意义的，因为别人会立刻把它从你手中夺走。

sentences.en: He absolutely needs state sponsorship.
sentences.zh: 你需要一个国家来保卫它，来说明这是我们的特许权。

sentences.en: He's like a man dreaming of a tech startup or something who needs state sponsorship, not just because he needs the sort of, as it were, the venture capital, but there's no point
sentences.zh: 这是我们的贸易港口，无论它是什么。

sentences.en: getting to somewhere and then not being backed up by a state because somebody will take it from you straight away.
sentences.zh: 所以问题就变成了，哪个国家？

sentences.en: You need a state to defend it, to say, this is our concession.
sentences.zh: 我想我们现在应该休息一下了。

sentences.en: This is our trading port, whatever it might be.
sentences.zh: 当我们回来时，让我们看看哥伦布是如何获得他最终得到的赞助的。

sentences.en: And so the question then becomes, which state?
sentences.zh: 这是我们的贸易港口，无论它是什么。

sentences.en: And I think we should take a break at this point.
sentences.zh: 所以问题就变成了，哪个国家？

sentences.en: And when we come back, let's look at how it is that Columbus comes to get the sponsors that he ends up with.
sentences.zh: 我想我们现在应该休息一下了。

sentences.en: We'll be back in a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们几分钟后回来。

sentences.en: Hello, welcome back to The Rest is History.
sentences.zh: 你好，欢迎回到《历史的余味》（The Rest is History）。

sentences.en: We are telling the story of Christopher Columbus.
sentences.zh: 我们正在讲述克里斯托弗·哥伦布的故事。

sentences.en: And Dominic, when we left, he is in Lisbon.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，我们上次讲到他的时候，他人在里斯本。

sentences.en: He is married.
sentences.zh: 他结婚了。

sentences.en: He's had a son who will be called by the Spanish Diego.
sentences.zh: 他有个儿子，后来被西班牙人称为迭戈。

sentences.en: He is a book dealer.
sentences.zh: 他是个图书商。

sentences.en: He has a background in sailing, both in the Mediterranean and the Atlantic.
sentences.zh: 他在地中海和大西洋都有航海背景。

sentences.en: And he's starting to get this idea that perhaps it's possible to cross the Atlantic and get to Asia, but he needs a state sponsor.
sentences.zh: 他开始萌生一个想法，或许可以横渡大西洋到达亚洲，但他需要一个国家赞助。

sentences.en: So he's in Portugal.
sentences.zh: 所以他当时在葡萄牙。

sentences.en: So presumably he turns to the King of Portugal, does he?
sentences.zh: 那么想必他转向了葡萄牙国王，是吗？

sentences.en: He does indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: Before I say that, I will just say one thing, which is that I'm very relieved, Tom, that you didn't bring us back in with your soprano's voice, which I thought was possible.
sentences.zh: 但在我回答之前，我只想说一件事，汤姆，我很庆幸你没有用你那男高音的嗓子带我们开场，我本来还以为你会那样做。

sentences.en: And we've dodged a bit of a bullet there, I think we can all say.
sentences.zh: 我想我们大家都得说，我们算是躲过一劫。

sentences.en: Yeah, Portugal is the obvious place to go.
sentences.zh: 没错，葡萄牙是显而易见的选择。

sentences.en: The Portuguese are the big expansionists.
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙人是伟大的扩张主义者。

sentences.en: He's in Portugal.
sentences.zh: 他人在葡萄牙。

sentences.en: He has Portuguese connections.
sentences.zh: 他有葡萄牙的人脉。

sentences.en: So he goes to King Zhao II, friend of the show.
sentences.zh: 所以他去找了若昂二世国王，我们节目的老朋友。

sentences.en: Very much a friend of The Rest is History.
sentences.zh: 确实是《历史的余味》的老朋友。

sentences.en: We did a whole series about Portugal in the Age of Discovery last year.
sentences.zh: 去年我们专门做了一系列关于大航海时代葡萄牙的节目。

sentences.en: So if you haven't heard that, do check it out.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没听过，一定要去听听。

sentences.en: Now, the Portuguese, I mean, the funny thing is they turn him down.
sentences.zh: 现在，葡萄牙人，我的意思是，有趣的是他们拒绝了他。

sentences.en: So it's a bit like sort of Decker turning down the Beatles or something.
sentences.zh: 这有点像迪卡唱片公司拒绝了披头士乐队之类的感觉。

sentences.en: But the thing is, the Portuguese are absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，葡萄牙人完全正确。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So right away, they identify the flaw in the plan.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一眼就看出了计划中的缺陷。

sentences.en: They say, we don't believe.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们不相信。

sentences.en: So the King commissions a commission of inquiry to look into this.
sentences.zh: 于是国王委派了一个调查委员会来研究此事。

sentences.en: And they say, you know, Japan is much further away than you think it is.
sentences.zh: 他们说，你知道，日本比你想象的要远得多。

sentences.en: Your calculations are all wrong.
sentences.zh: 你的计算全错了。

sentences.en: You will not get to Asia.
sentences.zh: 你到不了亚洲。

sentences.en: No expedition can be kitted out with enough food and water.
sentences.zh: 没有任何探险队能配备足够的食物和水。

sentences.en: No crew will stay kind of quiescent for so long.
sentences.zh: 没有任何船员能在那样的环境下保持安静那么久。

sentences.en: And in all that, the Portuguese are completely and utterly right.
sentences.zh: 在所有这些方面，葡萄牙人是彻头彻尾的正确。

sentences.en: And Columbus, ironically, is completely and utterly wrong.
sentences.zh: 而讽刺的是，哥伦布是彻头彻尾的错误。

sentences.en: But also the Portuguese have understood that the best way to get to India, which is really where people want to get to,
sentences.zh: 但葡萄牙人也明白，去往印度——那才是人们真正想去的地方——的最佳途径，

sentences.en: is going down the coast of Africa, around the coast of Cape Hope.
sentences.zh: 是沿着非洲海岸航行，绕过好望角。

sentences.en: And that's the focus of all their energies and efforts, right?
sentences.zh: 那是他们所有精力和努力的焦点，对吧？

sentences.en: The Portuguese are too successful for Columbus because their eastward voyages, their voyages around Africa are incredibly lucrative.
sentences.zh: 葡萄牙人对哥伦布来说太成功了，因为他们的东向航行，他们绕过非洲的航行，利润极其丰厚。

sentences.en: They're going great guns down there, sort of Bartholomew Diaz, Diego Cao, all these people going around the Cape of Cape Hope.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里进展神速，巴托洛梅乌·迪亚士、迭戈·康，所有这些人都在绕过好望角。

sentences.en: This is all an absolute triumph for them.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说绝对是一场胜利。

sentences.en: Why are they going to throw away a load of money on an expedition that, as their own experts say, is completely sort of, is crackers?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么要浪费大笔钱去资助一个连他们自己的专家都说是完全疯了的探险呢？

sentences.en: They see Columbus as a crank.
sentences.zh: 他们把哥伦布看作一个怪人。

sentences.en: I suppose he is a crank.
sentences.zh: 我想他确实是个怪人。

sentences.en: Well, he is.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他确实是。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, this is the irony that he's both-
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就是讽刺之处，他既是——

sentences.en: A visionary and a crank.
sentences.zh: 一个梦想家，也是一个怪人。

sentences.en: Yes, just what I was going to say.
sentences.zh: 没错，我正想说这个。

sentences.en: He's a visionary and a crank.
sentences.zh: 他既是梦想家，也是怪人。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Exactly, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，没错。

sentences.en: Kind of Elon Musk-esque, only not as rich, obviously.
sentences.zh: 有点像埃隆·马斯克，当然没那么有钱。

sentences.en: Yes, a much less rich and more Italian Elon Musk, I think, if you can imagine that.
sentences.zh: 是的，我想如果能想象的话，他是一个没那么有钱、更具意大利风情的埃隆·马斯克。

sentences.en: So where does he turn next?
sentences.zh: 那么他接下来转向哪里呢？

sentences.en: He turns to Castile.
sentences.zh: 他转向了卡斯蒂利亚。

sentences.en: So Castile is Portugal's kind of rival on the Iberian Peninsula, really.
sentences.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚实际上是葡萄牙在伊比利亚半岛的竞争对手。

sentences.en: Castile has been united with Aragon, another Spanish kingdom, through marriage to the Union of the Crowns of Ferdinand of Aragon and Isabella of Castile in 1479.
sentences.zh: 1479年，通过阿拉贡的斐迪南和卡斯蒂利亚的伊莎贝拉的联姻，卡斯蒂利亚与另一个西班牙王国阿拉贡实现了联合。

sentences.en: The Castilians have already expanded a little bit, not as much as the Portuguese.
sentences.zh: 卡斯蒂利亚人已经进行了一些扩张，虽然不如葡萄牙人那么多。

sentences.en: They've taken the Canary Islands, and they are fighting a war to conquer Granada.
sentences.zh: 他们占领了加那利群岛，并且正在进行征服格拉纳达的战争。

sentences.en: Now, I mentioned the Canary Islands.
sentences.zh: 现在，我提到了加那利群岛。

sentences.en: That is, again, this idea that Columbus comes out of this kind of clear blue sky is not right, because the Canary Islands are kind of like an experiment.
sentences.zh: 这再次说明，哥伦布是从天而降的想法是不对的，因为加那利群岛就像一个实验场。

sentences.en: They're like a laboratory in which the Spanish colonization of the Americas is already, in a weird way, underway.
sentences.zh: 它们就像一个实验室，西班牙对美洲的殖民在某种奇怪的方式下已经在那里进行了。

sentences.en: So they're using private finance.
sentences.zh: 所以他们在使用私人资金。

sentences.en: There are arguments on the Canary Islands.
sentences.zh: 在加那利群岛上存在争议。

sentences.en: Should we convert the indigenous people to Christianity, or should we enslave them?
sentences.zh: 我们应该让原住民皈依基督教，还是应该奴役他们？

sentences.en: And they've imported an alien crop, sugar, and started plantations right there in the Canary Islands.
sentences.zh: 而且他们引入了一种外来作物——糖，并直接在加那利群岛开始了种植园。

sentences.en: So there in Embryo, you can actually see so many of the patterns that will change life in what's now Latin America forever.
sentences.zh: 所以就在那里，你可以看到许多将永远改变现在拉丁美洲生活的模式的雏形。

sentences.en: But also, you can see patterns that will change, that will be introduced to America within Iberia itself.
sentences.zh: 但同时，你也能看到在伊比利亚半岛内部就会被引入美洲的模式。

sentences.en: Because you mentioned the war against Granada.
sentences.zh: 因为你提到了针对格拉纳达的战争。

sentences.en: This is part of an ongoing process that's been lasting for centuries, the Reconquista,
sentences.zh: 这是持续了几个世纪的“收复失地运动”的一部分，

sentences.en: the attempt to reconquer vast swathes of Spain that have been conquered by the Arabs way back.
sentences.zh: 试图收复很久以前被阿拉伯人征服的西班牙大片领土。

sentences.en: And it's been a very, very successful, if protracted, process.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常、非常成功，尽管旷日持久的过程。

sentences.en: And now there is this one kingdom left, the Kingdom of Granada, which actually has been very, very,
sentences.zh: 现在只剩下一个王国了，格拉纳达王国，实际上它一直非常……

sentences.en: keeping Granada in one way makes kind of better financial sense for the Spanish monarchs, Ferdinand and Isabella,
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上保留格拉纳达对西班牙君主斐迪南和伊莎贝拉来说，在财务上更有意义，

sentences.en: because the King of Granada has access to all the gold that is coming up from the Muslim south.
sentences.zh: 因为格拉纳达国王可以获得从穆斯林南方涌入的所有黄金。

sentences.en: And so he can pay this as tribute.
sentences.zh: 所以他可以支付这笔贡金。

sentences.en: But Ferdinand and Isabella want to annex Granada partly because they feel that it's a Trojan horse.
sentences.zh: 但斐迪南和伊莎贝拉想要吞并格拉纳达，部分原因是他们觉得它是一匹特洛伊木马。

sentences.en: It's a danger with the great Muslim power of the Ottomans spreading westwards.
sentences.zh: 随着强大的穆斯林势力奥斯曼帝国向西扩张，这是一种危险。

sentences.en: But also, I think, because they feel a sense of destiny, they feel that they've been called upon by God to redeem the whole of Iberia for Christendom.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，也是因为他们感受到了一种命运感，他们觉得上帝召唤他们为基督教世界收复整个伊比利亚半岛。

sentences.en: And it's that mixture of hard-headed commercial sense and kind of apocalyptic feeling of self-appointment that will infuse the spirit of the Spanish conquistadors in the new world.
sentences.zh: 正是这种精明的商业头脑与某种末日般的使命感相结合，注入了新世界西班牙征服者的精神中。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 是的，那绝对正确。

sentences.en: They have a profound sense of mission, don't they?
sentences.zh: 他们有一种深刻的使命感，不是吗？

sentences.en: They see themselves as appointed by God.
sentences.zh: 他们视自己为上帝的选民。

sentences.en: They're very in with the Pope.
sentences.zh: 他们与教皇关系非常密切。

sentences.en: They want to wipe Granada off the map.
sentences.zh: 他们想把格拉纳达从地图上抹去。

sentences.en: And that sort of crusading zeal, I mean, crusading is absolutely the word, because Ferdinand of Aragon, his great obsession is to go on crusade, is to recapture Jerusalem.
sentences.zh: 那种十字军东征的热情，我的意思是，十字军东征这个词绝对准确，因为阿拉贡的斐迪南，他最大的执念就是进行十字军东征，就是夺回耶路撒冷。

sentences.en: And actually, one of the reasons he ends up investing in Columbus's scheme is because he thinks, this will give me money for what I really want to do, which is to launch a crusade.
sentences.zh: 实际上，他最终投资哥伦布计划的原因之一，是因为他认为，这能为我真正想做的事情提供资金，那就是发动一场十字军东征。

sentences.en: Because the Spanish have this idea that the last emperor of all who will capture Jerusalem and then the second coming will begin, is lurking somewhere.
sentences.zh: 因为西班牙人有一种想法，即那位将夺回耶路撒冷然后开启第二次降临的最后一位皇帝，正潜伏在某处。

sentences.en: El Incubiato, the hidden one.
sentences.zh: “隐匿者”（El Incubiato）。

sentences.en: And Ferdinand, I think, starts to, you know, just to nurture the possibility that perhaps that's who he is.
sentences.zh: 我想斐迪南开始，你知道，开始培养这种可能性，也许他就是那个人。

sentences.en: So that kind of, Columbus has a kind of crankish element.
sentences.zh: 所以那种，哥伦布有一种怪人的成分。

sentences.en: Ferdinand is not entirely hostile to that.
sentences.zh: 斐迪南对此并不完全排斥。

sentences.en: No, I think you're right, Tom.
sentences.zh: 不，我想你是对的，汤姆。

sentences.en: And then some friars actually have told Ferdinand, you probably are that last emperor, which must be a nice thing to hear.
sentences.zh: 而且一些修士实际上告诉过斐迪南，你可能就是那位最后的皇帝，这听起来一定很不错。

sentences.en: I mean, it's quite a responsibility, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这责任相当重大，我想。

sentences.en: It is a big responsibility.
sentences.zh: 确实责任重大。

sentences.en: But, you know, if you've got a bit of self-confidence, which Columbus actually doesn't, that Ferdinand clearly does, he thinks, well, you know, if the Catholics...
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，如果你有一点自信——哥伦布其实没有，但斐迪南显然有——他会想，好吧，如果天主教徒……

sentences.en: Yeah, let's go for it.
sentences.zh: 是的，放手去做吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So Columbus's first port of call is a monastery called La Rabida, which is in the south of Spain.
sentences.zh: 所以哥伦布的第一站是一个叫拉拉比达的修道院，位于西班牙南部。

sentences.en: Franciscan.
sentences.zh: 方济各会。

sentences.en: The Franciscan monastery.
sentences.zh: 方济各会修道院。

sentences.en: These guys are full of all this kind of talk in this monastery.
sentences.zh: 这些人在修道院里满口都是这种言论。

sentences.en: But they're also, they're very learned.
sentences.zh: 但他们也非常博学。

sentences.en: So one of the people who is there is one of the, it turns out, is actually one of the leading astronomers of the period.
sentences.zh: 所以其中一个人，事实证明，实际上是那个时代领先的天文学家之一。

sentences.en: He's a guy called Antonio de Marchena.
sentences.zh: 他叫安东尼奥·德·马切纳。
